headline: Urso, New Agreement Between Italy and the Emirates on Industry and Technology - News - Ansa.it
summary: Italian Minister Adolfo Urso signed a memorandum of understanding in Abu Dhabi with UAE Investment Minister Mohamed Hassan Al Suwaidi. It aims to promote reciprocal investment in industry and manufacturing.
why: Bilateral investment agreements between governments can open cross-border opportunities for manufacturers and investors in both countries.
